title: Eclipse Detective
description: A silhouetted figure in a blue fedora and ornate coat stands centered, holding a golden key in one hand and a large magnifying glass revealing a detailed eye in the other. The background features a glowing red and black solar eclipse with dripping blood-like effects, floating eyeballs in bubbles, and the word 'TRUTH' formed from twisted branches above.
prompt: A mysterious silhouetted detective figure wearing a blue fedora with a glowing red eye emblem and an ornate multicolored coat stands in the center. He holds a golden ornate key in his right hand and a large magnifying glass showing a realistic eye in his left. Floating transparent bubbles containing eyeballs surround him. Above is a dark solar eclipse with red corona and dripping red liquid, with the word TRUTH spelled in twisted black branches. Psychedelic swirling ground and roots. Dark surreal symbolic style with vibrant accents.
